violated_contract: A provider dispatch whose fenced result checkpoint proves it completed with no words is a definitive outcome; held-audio recovery must settle it as a transcribed, no-content piece with no usage and no retry. Routing it through the ambiguous-call reconciliation path (cooldown, ingest-proof lookup, one re-dispatch) turns the second identical empty reply into a terminal failed_reconciliation that retains the audio forever and pins the owner's held-audio summary.
canonical_prevention: Classify a dispatch outcome from the persisted provider checkpoint rather than the local reply flag: a dispatched receipt carrying provider_empty with provider_completed_at settles in place as transcribed/has_content=False/seconds=0, on the same pass and when a later pass resumes it, under its own closed reconciliation outcome; only a dispatch with no completion checkpoint remains ambiguous. Cover single-piece, resume, mixed-sibling and genuinely ambiguous holds, including exactly-once summary settlement.
